source.author: verg
source.text: adiuro Stygii caput implacabile fontis, una superstitio superis quae reddita divis.
source.text_original: adiuro Stygii caput implacabile fontis, / una superstitio superis quae reddita divis.
source.text_english: I adjure by the inexorable source of the Stygian stream, the one rite given back to the upper gods.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: idem per Stygiam paludem sanctissime iurat, una superstitio superis quae reddita diuis .
reuse.text_original: idem per Stygiam paludem sanctissime iurat, una superstitio superis quae reddita diuis .
reuse.text_english: he swears the same thing most solemnly by the Stygian marsh, a single superstition that has been handed back to the gods above.
